answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 155864 Country: India Title: When we sleep can we read Quran that time at mobile? Question: When we sleep can we read Quran that time at mobile? Answer ID: 155864 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 205/163/B=2/1439) It is the etiquette of the Holy Quran to recite it in the state of wudhu, turning towards Qiblah, and in sitting position. One can read the Holy Quran in the mobile as well while maintaining these etiquettes. It is not good to recite the Holy Quran in lying position. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
